configurations.name: eaweb
configurations._comment: Default dev host. Runs the no-store DevServer (web/DevServer), NOT `dotnet run` on the WASM client, so index.html / wwwroot JS / Content assets (textures, shaders, .dat, music.json, brainoverlays.json, ...) are NEVER served stale. The stock blazor-devserver has no cache-header knob, so serving through DevServer is the only way to kill the stale-asset trap by default. DevServer references ../EvilAliensWeb, so this builds + serves the client.

configurations.name: eaweb-fresh
configurations._comment: Alias of `eaweb` on a second port (both now serve no-store via DevServer). Kept because older docs/notes reference port 5290.

configurations.name: eaweb-wt1
configurations._comment: Worktree wt1 via ITS OWN no-store DevServer (references that worktree's EvilAliensWeb) — same cache-proof serving, per tree.
